name: Tamoxifen
summary: Tamoxifen, marketed under the brand name Nolvadex (among others), is a selective estrogen receptor modulator sometimes used in breast cancer drug regimens for women and men. It is also being studied for other types of cancer. It has been used for Albright syndrome. Tamoxifen is usually administered orally for five years for breast cancer.

pharmacology.text: Tamoxifen, marketed under the brand name Nolvadex (among others), is a selective estrogen receptor modulator sometimes used in breast cancer drug regimens for women and men. Tamoxifen is a selective estrogen-receptor modulator (SERM) and works by decreasing the growth of breast cancer cells.

uses.text: Tamoxifen, marketed under the brand name Nolvadex (among others), is a selective estrogen receptor modulator sometimes used in breast cancer drug regimens for women and men. It is also being studied for other types of cancer. It has been used for Albright syndrome.

sideEffects.text: Serious side effects of tamoxifen can include increased risk of uterine cancer, stroke, ophthalmological problems, and pulmonary embolisms. Common side effects include irregular periods, weight loss, and hot flashes.

summaryZh: 他莫昔芬，以Nolvadex（有"諾瓦得士"的中文譯名）等品牌名稱於市場上銷售，是一種選擇性雌激素受體調節劑 ，針對女性和男性個體中具乳癌發病高風險族群的預防性投藥 。它也正被研究用於治療其他類型的癌症。此藥物曾被用於治療麥昆–奧爾布賴特症候群（多骨纖維發育不良症候群）。針對乳癌，他莫昔芬通常需要每天口服，持續五年。
summaryZhHans: 他莫昔芬，以Nolvadex（有"诺瓦得士"的中文译名）等品牌名称于市场上销售，是一种选择性雌激素受体调节剂 ，针对女性和男性个体中具乳癌发病高风险族群的预防性投药 。它也正被研究用于治疗其他类型的癌症。此药物曾被用于治疗麦昆–奥尔布赖特症候群（多骨纤维发育不良症候群）。针对乳癌，他莫昔芬通常需要每天口服，持续五年。

fact.en: Tamoxifen was first made in 1962 at the British company ICI during a search for a morning-after contraceptive pill. It failed at that, but became one of the most important breast cancer medicines ever made.
fact.zh: 他莫昔芬在1962年由英國ICI公司在研發事後避孕藥的過程中首次合成。它在避孕方面失敗了，卻成為史上最重要的乳癌藥物之一。
